text: No rain had fallen for forty days.
The fields cracked. The streams ran dry.
A thirsty crow found an old water jar.
There was water inside, but far too deep to reach.
She pushed. It would not tip. She pecked. It would not break.
Then she looked down at the pebbles.
One stone. Then another. Then another.
The sun burned. Her wings ached. She kept going.
